description: This file contains shell script code for configuring and managing WireGuard VPN interfaces in OpenWrt, including functions for setup, peer configuration, key generation, and teardown.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WireGuard protocol configuration with parameters like private key, listen port, mtu, and fwmark.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a WireGuard peer based on provided peer configuration, including public key, endpoint, allowed IPs, and persistent keepalive.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Checks if a private key is set for a network interface; if set to 'generate', creates a new key and stores it.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up a WireGuard interface, applies configuration, assigns IP addresses, and manages dependencies.
